Private credit funds show September stabilization as redemptions ease at Apollo, Ares, BlackRock and Blackstone.

Sep 27, 2026, 8:43 AM ET Apollo Global Management, Inc. (APO) Stock , BX Stock , BLK Stock , ARES Stock VPC , HYIN , PCMM , PCLO , PRIV , PCR By : Rob Williams , SA News Editor 1 Comment

Private credit funds saw signs of stabilizing in September as redemption requests from individual investors eased and investment performance improved after a difficult start to the year, the Financial Times reported Sunday.
